name: Snippet
description: A copyable shell command with a prompt that stays out of the copy.

command.description:
The command, or several commands shown one per line. Write the command
only: the prompt is chrome and never part of the text.

prompt.description: Show the `$` prompt before each command. Copy always leaves it out.

theme.description:
`inverted` renders the snippet in the dark theme on any page, for
terminal emphasis. In the high-contrast themes it follows the page so
contrast stays at the high-contrast level.

copyLabel.description: Accessible name for the copy button.

onCopy.description: Called with the copied text (commands joined by newlines).
